tasks.subject: Task 1: CsProc, the one process runner
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A process runner taking an argv array, never a shell string, with an injectable backend so everything above it is testable under node, and which redacts tokens from its log.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsProc.js`
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAll.js`
- Modify: `tests/js_unit.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `CsProc.run("git", ["--version"])` returns `{code, out, err, timedOut}`.
- [ ] `CsProc.setBackend(fn)` replaces execution; the fake receives program and argv unmodified, including an argument containing a space.
- [ ] `CsProc.redact` replaces ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_ tokens with `<redacted>`.
- [ ] The file evaluates under node with no ReferenceError -- no Q* reference outside a function body.
- [ ] `timedOut` true means `code` is non-zero.

**Verify:** `./tests/run_all.sh` -> ALL TESTS PASSED

**Steps:**
- Append the CsProc test section to tests/js_unit.js (14 assertions).
- Add scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsProc.js to CORE_FILES after CsUnits.js.
- Run the suite; expect 'cannot open .../CsProc.js'.
- Write CsProc.js: setBackend, redact, logPath, log, qprocessBackend, run.
- Run the suite; expect ALL TESTS PASSED.
- Add the include to CsAll.js after CsUnits.js.
- Commit.

tasks.subject: Task 8: verify the ladder in a real window
tasks.description:
**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Goal:** Confirm in a running CaveCAD, launched from Finder, that the tool appears, resolves gh, and reports every rung correctly.

**Files:**
- Modify: none expected. Any fix goes in the file that owns the failure.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `./tools/publish.sh` completes and reports the new version installed.
- [ ] CaveCAD is launched with `open -a CaveCAD` (Finder environment), NOT from a terminal.
- [ ] "GitHub Setup" appears in the Cave Survey menu.
- [ ] All six rungs report passing on this already-authenticated machine, proving gh was found despite the minimal Finder PATH.
- [ ] cave-git.log contains the probe's commands and ZERO token matches.

**Verify:** `cd ~/Documents/github/cavecad-tools && ./tools/publish.sh && open -a CaveCAD`, run the tool, then `grep -cE "gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{8,}" ~/Library/Application\ Support/QCAD/CaveCAD/cave-git.log` -> 0

**Steps:**
- Publish the add-on; a failure here is a test failure, not a GUI problem.
- Launch with `open -a CaveCAD` so the app gets launchd's minimal environment -- launching the binary directly would inherit the shell PATH and hide the exact bug Task 4 prevents.
- Run Cave Survey > GitHub Setup; expect six OK rungs.
- Check the log is written and contains no token.
- Append a dated GUI-verified line to the spec for items 1 and 4 only.
- Commit the spec update.
